tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Keyword search of the Acosta Curated Travel Knowledge Center: destination guides, travel news, entry requirements, and travel tips. Returns up to 10 summaries with links, best match first.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Returns one Knowledge Center article in full as plain text, with its link. Use a slug from search_articles.

tools.name: list_upcoming_experiences
tools.description: Upcoming small-group trips and cruises offered through Acosta Curated Travel, soonest first, with dates, destinations, highlights, and a link to each trip's page.

tools.name: get_contact_details
tools.description: How a traveler can reach Ivone Acosta to start planning a trip: contact page, email, phone, what to include, and a message they can adapt. The traveler sends it; never submit anything for them.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact_details · Private data: get_contact_details · Public sink: get_contact_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact_details · Private data: get_contact_details · Public sink: get_contact_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
